method.title: NIST/SEMATECH: exploratory outlier screening (modified z score)
method.interpretation: Own-history symmetric application screens, not probabilities, fraud findings, error determinations or race calls. Peer statistics are context only and never veto a border trigger.
method.madZeroPolicy: Advanced context retains absolute guards and null modifiedZ at MAD0; own-history triggers do not require peers.

flags.label: Democratic vote-count increase of at least 40%
flags.description: Provisional review: This party’s count changed by at least 40% and 100 votes from 2022, while the opposing party’s count changed by at most 15% in absolute size. flags.label: Democratic vote-count increase of at least 40%
flags.description: Provisional review: This party’s count changed by at least 40% and 100 votes from 2022, while the opposing party’s count changed by at most 15% in absolute size. State-peer statistics are context, not a veto. These application screening thresholds are not probabilities, error findings or evidence of fraud. Reporting progress and candidate changes may explain differences.

flags.label: Unusual Democratic vote-count growth with ordinary opposing growth
flags.description: Provisional review: Democrat counts increased at least 25% and 100 votes, at least 25 percentage points above same-state peer growth, with modified z >3.5 (MAD-zero absolute guard). Opposing-party growth is within |z|≤2, or within 10pp of its peer median when MAD=0. Reporting progress, candidate changes and voting patterns may explain this exploratory result; it is not an error or fraud finding.

flags.description: Provisional review: Candidate/write-in race votes per 100 residents changed by at least 10 percentage points. This race-vote proxy uses all residents including children; it is neither actual ballots nor eligible-voter turnout. These application screening thresholds are not probabilities, error findings or evidence of fraud. Reporting progress and candidate changes may explain differences.

flags.description: Provisional review: Candidate/write-in race votes per 100 residents changed by at least 10 percentage points. These application screening thresholds are not probabilities, error findings or evidence of fraud. Reporting progress and candidate changes may explain differences.

flags.label: Race votes per resident changed by at least 10pp
flags.description: Provisional review: Candidate/write-in race votes per 100 residents changed by at least 10 percentage points. This race-vote proxy uses all residents including children; it is neither actual ballots nor eligible-voter turnout. These application screening thresholds are not probabilities, error findings or evidence of fraud. Reporting progress and candidate changes may explain differences.

The substantial county-change list was checked; minor cartographic corrections were not individually adjudicated. limitations: This is a complete countywide aggregate, not a matched same-seat or same-candidate comparison.

comparability.basis: Actual county FIPS inventories in both years match the full Census 2024 roster. Each year’s real district portions are aggregated independently; no district votes are allocated to counties. The substantial county-change list was checked; minor cartographic corrections were not individually adjudicated. District boundaries, candidates and contestation can change, so a countywide difference does not determine a cause.
limitations: This is a complete countywide aggregate, not a matched same-seat or same-candidate comparison.
All current counts are provisional; complete source scope does not establish counting completion or certification.

Virginia’s direct official 2022 locality and district records control the baseline. Their write-in figures differ from the FEC workbook, including District 11: 852 versus 828. The official state figures are retained; the disagreement is not presented as a voting irregularity.

limitations: This is a complete countywide aggregate, not a matched same-seat or same-candidate comparison.

comparability.basis: Actual county FIPS inventories in both years match the full Census 2024 roster. Each year’s real district portions are aggregated independently; no district votes are allocated to counties. The substantial county-change list was checked; minor cartographic corrections were not individually adjudicated. District boundaries, candidates and contestation can change, so a countywide difference does not determine a cause.
limitations: This is a complete countywide aggregate, not a matched same-seat or same-candidate comparison.
All current counts are provisional; complete source scope does not establish counting completion or certification.

Virginia’s direct official 2022 locality and district records control the baseline. Their write-in figures differ from the FEC workbook, including District 11: 852 versus 828. The official state figures are retained; the disagreement is not presented as a voting irregularity.

comparability.basis: Actual county FIPS inventories in both years match the full Census 2024 roster. Each year’s real district portions are aggregated independently; no district votes are allocated to counties. The substantial county-change list was checked; minor cartographic corrections were not individually adjudicated. District boundaries, candidates and contestation can change, so a countywide difference does not determine a cause.
limitations: This is a complete countywide aggregate, not a matched same-seat or same-candidate comparison.
All current counts are provisional; complete source scope does not establish counting completion or certification.

Virginia’s direct official 2022 locality and district records control the baseline. Their write-in figures differ from the FEC workbook, including District 11: 852 versus 828. The official state figures are retained; the disagreement is not presented as a voting irregularity.
